trial_court: Court of learned Sub Registrar (Munsiff), Jammu, Cr. No. 9/2018
facts_of_case: The respondent filed a civil suit against the petitioner seeking declaration that their alleged marriage is illegal and inoperative. The petitioner sought rejection of the plaint on grounds of lack of jurisdiction.

legal_principles.principle: A plaint can be rejected by resort to Order VII Rule 11 (d) of the Code of Civil Procedure, Svt. 1977 if it is accepted as it is without any element of editing.
legal_principles.held: The elementary principle on which a plaint can be rejected by resort to Order VII Rule 11 (d) of the Code of Civil Procedure, Svt. 1977 is that the plaint is to be accepted as it is without any element of editing so as to generate a conclusion for the notice of the civil suit.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, Svt. 1977 — Order VII Rule 11 (d)

legal_principles.principle: A court examines a plaint filed in a civil suit to determine whether it deserves rejection.
legal_principles.held: This Court when examines the plaint filed in the civil suit, is confronted with the fact that the respondent has set up a fact, whether true or false is a subject matter of proof.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order rejecting the application to reject the plaint was set aside, and the suit was dismissed for want of jurisdiction.

keywords: Jammu and Kashmir Code of Civil Procedure Svt. 1977
